summary: KinderCare Learning Companies filed an 8-K regarding an Amended and Restated Fifth Amendment to its master lease with landlord KCP RE LLC, covering 545 childcare center sites. The amendment splits sites into six schedules with varying lease expirations (2029-2042), rent adjustment dates, and extension options. Thirteen sites were transferred to an affiliate landlord under a new lease. This is a routine contractual modification, not a special situation. No financial terms, board action, or strategic event are disclosed. The filing is operational in nature, with no special-situation implications or risk-arb angle.
